subject: West Ham sack Nuno after 13 months and bring back Scott Parker
title: West Ham's quick fix

lines.vo: Thirteen months. That is how long West Ham's patience lasted.
lines.footage: Nuno West Ham press conference or match clip

lines.vo: Scott Parker, forty-six, was confirmed the very next morning. Not a search. A reflex.
lines.footage: Scott Parker press conference West Ham

lines.vo: Nuno won only twice in six. He also lost at home to Southampton and West Brom. That is a verdict.
Parker's first game, at Cardiff: three-nil down by the thirty-ninth minute. Final score, three-three. A fast start, at the wrong end.
Parker has won promotion from this league three times: Fulham, Bournemouth and Burnley. A very specific CV for a very specific problem.
He played 129 times for West Ham before. Mark Noble will work closely with him. A reunion, with homework.

facts_used: West Ham dismissed Nuno on 3 November after just over 13 months; Scott Parker, 46, named on a 30-month deal (ev0018)

Parker's first match at Cardiff: West Ham trailed 3-0 by the 39th minute and drew 3-3 (ev0018)
